utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are gathering tools and spare parts this afternoon—sounds like a good turnout already.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure it’s this afternoon, right? I just want to confirm before I stop by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, that’s what I heard—this afternoon, around the community hall. I’d still swing by a little early just in case.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. I’ll try to keep an eye out for updates too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — first I’d like to sort the donated tools and see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll sort the donated tools and make a missing-items list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — that’d be a big help. I’m keeping track of what we still need, so I’ll let you know what to grab.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just tell me what’s needed and I’ll go grab it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be a huge help, Faye—thank you. I’ll line up the repair teams around those pickup and drop-off windows.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—send me the time windows and I’ll work them into the school schedule. I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Oren—just tell me the plan and the time, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Eli. I’ll sort out the plan and the time, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Oren. Just let me know when it’s set, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—want me to invite a few neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please—just a few, and maybe mention the time and what kinds of repairs we’re handling so people know what to expect.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll invite a few neighbors and mention it starts at the usual time, with small home repairs, bike fixes, and basic tune-ups. I’ll keep it simple so people know what to expect.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Nell, I’m getting the repair drive organized and wanted to see if you can help spread the word on the block.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, Rosa — I can pass it along to folks I’ve heard from. Just let me know the details, and I’ll share what I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m listening, Mara—what details do we know about the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I don’t have any solid details yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara. I’ll hold off for now and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I need to stay in character and reply only with the exact JSON format.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll keep it in character and reply in the exact JSON format.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: {"utterance":"I can come by for a bit, but I’ll need to keep it brief today."}

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand, and I’ve got a few tools you can borrow for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What tools are you offering, and when can I pick them up?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a hammer, a cordless drill, and a tape measure you can borrow. I’ll be home after 5, so come by anytime then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m heading to the repair drive now—it's by the community center on Maple, right? If you know the exact drop-off spot, I’ll make sure I go straight there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that sounds right — community center on Maple. I’d just head to the main drop-off area near the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll go to the main drop-off area by the entrance at the community center on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know what we end up needing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rey — just give me a shout when you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a little worried about the logistics—do we know when the repair drive starts and where people should drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—have we confirmed the start time and drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, I don’t think. Once we confirm both, I can help spread the word so people aren’t showing up at the wrong time or place.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m in for the repair drive — happy to help connect folks and pitch in wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Jules — thank you. I’ll keep you posted as the repair drive gets organized.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — just let me know what you need from me, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got for the repair drive and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I might join a bit late, but I can help once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll keep a list and let you know what’s still needed when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard a few folks are already pitching in for the repair drive. If you want, I can tell you what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be great, Tess — I’m trying to fit this around school pickup, so knowing what’s still needed would really help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — they still need a few volunteer hands, plus some cash donations and a couple of tool donations. I can also tell you the best time to drop things off if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what's the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’ve got the main list together, and I’m lining up volunteers and supplies now. If you can help with pickups or referrals, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help with pickups. Send me the list when you have it, and I’ll see who I can refer too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you grab a box of tape and some markers for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I can grab those and bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Nell, the repair drive is coming up soon — would you like me to pass your name along?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, yes please — that’d be really helpful. Thanks for keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add your name and let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still keeping an eye on the repair drive location—if you want, I can help sort out where it’s being held.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal—I'd appreciate that. Let me know the location and we’ll keep it straightforward.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check the latest and get you the exact location as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get a date yet, Hana?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet — I’m checking the details before I confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — when you know, can you let me know the date and what needs bringing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let folks know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that a lot. I’ll keep it moving on my end and try not to forget anything important.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll check in with a few neighbors while I’m out and pass along anything useful. We’ll keep this moving.
